llm.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
llm.notes: Gemini API paid tier, Standard, text/image/video/audio input. Page labels output as 'Output price (including thinking tokens)'. ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing 301-redirects here. Batch/Flex $0.15 in / $1.25 out; Priority $0.54 / $4.50. Implicit context caching only: $0.03 per 1M cached tokens + $1.00 per 1M tokens per hour storage.

llm.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
llm.notes: PROMOTIONAL price valid through 2026-12-31; from 2027-01-01 list price rises to $1.50 in / $7.50 out. Output includes thinking tokens. Cache read $0.075 (then $0.15). Batch $0.375 / $1.875 (then $0.75 / $3.75). Gemini 3.6 Flash (previous gen) has identical prices.

llm.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (top Pro model listed on the pricing page)
llm.notes: Prompts <=200k tokens; >200k is $4.00 in / $18.00 out. No free tier. Cache read $0.20 (<=200k) + $4.50 per 1M tokens/hour storage. Batch $1.00 / $6.00. No 'Gemini 3.5 Pro' is listed on the page.

llm.name: Gemini 4 Argon (Google flagship reasoning model, for comparison)
llm.notes: PROMOTIONAL price valid through 2026-11-30; from 2026-12-01 rises to $4.00 in / $20.00 out. Model id not captured from the page (null). llm.name: OpenAI GPT-5.4 mini (mid-tier chat)

other_notes: free tier data-use policy: the Gemini API pricing page lists, for Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.8 Flash, 'Used to improve our products' = Yes on the Free tier and No on the Paid tier. The Free card says 'Content used to improve our products.' So free-tier prompts and responses may be used by Google for product improvement; paid-tier content is not.

Gemini context caching: gemini-3.5-flash-lite supports implicit caching only (explicit not supported); cache-read price $0.03/MTok (10% of the $0.30 input price) plus $1.00/MTok/hour storage. Provider-side caching only discounts matching input tokens and output is still billed; a semantic cache avoids the LLM call entirely (saves input and output).

Date-sensitive LLM prices: Gemini 3.8 Flash is promotional until 2026-12-31 (doubles in 2027); Gemini 4 Argon is promotional until 2026-11-30 (doubles 2026-12-01). Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.1 Pro Preview are the stable figures.
Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash are deprecated and route to newer models from 2026-12-01.

Hosting prices are from third-party aggregators, not the official GCP/AWS pages (not fetchable as text). Not included: egress, snapshots, load balancer, NAT, committed-use or sustained-use discounts, Autopilot Pod resource billing.
